::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jany 19th 1877  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Yale University, Beinecke Library
:::

Sir

I am grateful for what you say of the [Scripture Readings](cmy_books/cmybook_87.qmd), I did consider of the use of paragraphs, but as I meant the book primarily for school reading I though the loss of verses would be inconvenient, and I myself do not like using a paragraph Bible because I can never find anything quickly in it

Perhaps I was actuated by my childish dislike to [Lloyd’s Bible](other_books/otherbook_1133.qmd) which used to seem to me unnatural.

yours truly

C M Yonge
